Fit the Joint Bernoulli Resistance-Profile Model

Source: R/profile_fit.R
profile_fit_joint_bernoulli.Rd

Compiles inst/stan/joint_bernoulli_general.stan (or a caller- supplied alternative) and samples it against a Stan-ready design from profile_build_design, saving every artifact a later review needs: the fit object (fit.rds), a parameter summary (parameter_summary.csv), per-chain sampler diagnostics (sampler_diagnostics.rds), a snapshot of the exact sampler config used, hashed for reproducibility (config_snapshot.rds), and a short human-readable run log (run_log.txt). cmdstanr's own per-chain CSV files are also written into output_dir (via output_dir forwarded to $sample()).

Usage

profile_fit_joint_bernoulli(
  design,
  output_dir,
  sampler_config = list(),
  stan_file = NULL,
  save_warmup = FALSE
)

Arguments

design

Output of profile_build_design (reads design$stan_data; design$manifest is recorded in the config snapshot for provenance).

output_dir

Character. Directory for all artifacts (created if missing).

sampler_config

Named list. Any of chains (default 4L), iter_warmup (1000L), iter_sampling (1000L), seed (123L), parallel_chains (default: = chains), adapt_delta (0.9), max_treedepth (10L), threads_per_chain (1L – > 1 enables reduce_sum threading in the Stan model's grainsize machinery). Unset entries use these defaults.

stan_file

Character or NULL. Default: the package's inst/stan/joint_bernoulli_general.stan.

save_warmup

Logical, forwarded to $sample(). Default FALSE.

Value

A list: fit (the cmdstanr CmdStanMCMC object), summary (data frame, fit$summary()), diagnostics (list from fit$diagnostic_summary()), config (the resolved sampler config, the design manifest, and config_hash), output_dir.
